message:
You know that one friend who panics at the first sign of a storm? I try to remind myself that a little preparation goes a long way in keeping things calm. I stumbled upon a resource from the National Weather Service that lays out some sensible safety tips to consider when storms roll in. It’s handy to have a plan so when the wind picks up, you’re not scrambling like a chicken with its head cut off. 

What’s your favorite tip for staying calm during a storm? 🌧️
